detail.title: 一种液泵压力异常报警装置
detail.abstract: The utility model proposes a kind of liquid pump pressure abnormal alarming device, including: pressure transducer (3), pressure transducer (3) is arranged on the outlet of liquid pump (2)；Receiving pressure transducer (3) hydraulic pressure that detects and judge the control unit (4) whether this hydraulic pressure falls within normal range, control unit (4) is electrically connected to pressure transducer (3)；Alarm (5), described alarm (5) controlled unit (4) controls to send alarm signal.The utility model has the advantages that and be mounted with pressure transducer in liquid pump exit, when force value is not in normal range of operation, alarm can be triggered and shut down, remind operator, prevent from damaging liquid pump and avoiding invalid operation.
assignees: 北京百瑞盛田环保科技发展有限公司
